monetization_evidence.evidence: The Threads bio links to beautifuldestinations.com, the site of a travel marketing agency. The agency lists clients 'Turkish Airlines, Brand USA, Saudi Tourism Authority, Accor, Visit Panama, and Red Sea Global' and says it reaches 'over 50 million engaged travellers across our channels' with a 'built-in audience'. The link suggests @beautifulhotels is one of the agency's owned channels. That is INFERRED: the site does not name @beautifulhotels.

Accor case study: 'Grew from a single hotel pilot to becoming Accor's global travel content production partner, creating over 1,000 assets across 50 hotels in the Middle East Africa Asia-Pacific (MEA APAC) and multiple brands.' It does not say which Instagram accounts carried the content.

Captions name specific properties and credit a creator. Examples: C7PFB2NIp-e '@kamashrafi might have found Dubai's best viewpoint! 🇦🇪 The luxury Address Skyview Hotel ...', CwDUsjvBzG_ '@enrico_costantini transports us to Villa Peduzzi in Lake Como', DWtiyElocII 'Milaidhoo Maldives is a hotel that offers a more understated take on an island stay'. The Paid partnership label could not be checked, so whether these posts are sponsored is unknown.

Threads posts use the same format, crediting creator and location: '@cvlager gives us a peek inside one of Ibiza's most exclusive escapes, Villa Infinity! ... 📽️ @cvlager 📍Villa Infinity, Ibiza, Spain' and '@travelwithcorvus ... Hotel Tramonto D'Oro on the Amalfi Coast ... 📽️ @travelwithcorvus 📍Hotel Tramonto D'Oro, Amalfi Coast, Italy'.
Searches for paid partnerships, sponsors, courses and storefronts could NOT be run because the WebSearch budget was used up. No affiliate booking links or storefront were seen.

content_mode_evidence: Every sampled caption credits a named human creator ('@kamashrafi', '@enrico_costantini', '@adinistorfoto', '@tjbetrippin'). Threads posts use '📽️ @creator 📍Place' credits. All featured hotels are real and bookable. The parent company describes 'authentic, on-location content'. Its About page also mentions 'an AI-powered production workflow', but no AI-generated visuals were identified in the sample. None of these reels was frame-coded in the repo.
niche_focus: Curated luxury and unique hotels, villas and cabins worldwide (Dubai, Lake Como, Maldives, Lapland, Ibiza, Amalfi). It is a hospitality sub-brand of the Beautiful Destinations travel-media and marketing agency.
cta_pattern: Credit-first captions ('@creator transports us to / gives us a peek inside <property>'), a descriptive paragraph, then a question prompt for comments ('Who are you bringing with you?', 'Tell us your top hidden gems in Tulum...', 'What's the prettiest view you've ever enjoyed from a hotel window?'). Credits and location use 📽️ @creator 📍Property, Place. No booking link in the captions. B2B monetization runs through the parent agency (brands@beautifuldestinations.com).
